items.source: candidateAdviceMethod - the candidate advice method
items.translation: candidateAdviceMethod - 候选建议方法

items.source: aspectInstanceFactory - the aspect instance factory
items.translation: aspectInstanceFactory - 切面实例工厂

items.source: declarationOrder - the declaration order within the aspect
items.translation: declarationOrder - 切面内的声明顺序

items.source: null if the method is not an AspectJ advice method or if it is a pointcut that will be used by other advice but will not create a Spring advice in its own right
items.translation: 如果该方法不是 AspectJ 建议方法，或者它是一个将被其他建议使用但本身不会创建 Spring 建议的切入点，则返回`null`。

items.source: Will simply return false if the supposed aspect is invalid (such as an extension of a concrete aspect class). Will return true for some aspects that Spring AOP cannot process, such as those with unsupported instantiation models. Use the validate(Class) method to handle these cases if necessary.
items.translation: 如果所谓的切面无效（例如是具体切面类的扩展），将简单地返回 `false`。对于 Spring AOP 无法处理的一些切面，也将返回 `true`，例如那些具有不支持的实例化模型的切面。如有必要，请使用 validate(Class) 方法来处理这些情况。

items.source: Build a Spring AOP Advice for the given AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 为给定的 AspectJ 建议方法构建一个 Spring AOP 建议。

items.source: Build a Spring AOP Advisor for the given AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 为给定的 AspectJ 建议方法构建一个 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source:
Build Spring AOP Advisors for all annotated At-AspectJ methods
on the specified aspect instance.
items.translation: 为指定的切面实例上所有带注解的 AspectJ 方法构建 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source: Is the given class a valid AspectJ aspect class?
items.translation: 该给定的类是否是有效的 AspectJ 方面类？

items.source: NotAnAtAspectException - if the class is not an aspect at all (which may or may not be legal, depending on the context)
items.translation: NotAnAtAspectException - 如果该类根本不是切面（这在某些上下文中可能是合法的，而在其他上下文中则不然）

items.source: aspectInstanceFactory - the aspect instance factory (not the aspect instance itself in order to avoid eager instantiation)
items.translation: aspectInstanceFactory - 方面实例工厂（而非方面实例本身，以避免过早实例化）

items.source: aspectName - the name of the aspect
items.translation: aspectName - 切面的名称

items.source: expressionPointcut - the AspectJ expression pointcut
items.translation: expressionPointcut - AspectJ 表达式切点

items.source: a list of advisors for this class
items.translation: 该类的顾问列表

items.source: Determine whether the given class is an aspect, as reported by AspectJ's AjTypeSystem.
items.translation: 确定给定类是否为 AspectJ 的 `AjTypeSystem` 报告的方面。

items.source:
Interface for factories that can create Spring AOP Advisors from classes
annotated with AspectJ annotation syntax.
items.translation: 用于从使用 AspectJ 注解语法标注的类创建 Spring AOP Advisor 的工厂接口。

items.source: AopConfigException - if the class is an invalid aspect (which can never be legal)
items.translation: `AopConfigException` - 如果该类是一个无效的切面（这永远是不合法的）

items.source: clazz - the supposed annotation-style AspectJ class
items.translation: clazz - 假设的注解式 AspectJ 类

items.source: aspectClass - the supposed AspectJ annotation-style class to validate
items.translation: aspectClass - 要验证的假设的 AspectJ 注解风格类

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller

items.source: whether this class is recognized by AspectJ as an aspect class
items.translation: 该类是否被 AspectJ 识别为方面类。
